title: CGX-Native Physical Object Identity Contract
purpose: Generalize the printer-node identity into a reusable lifecycle identity for physical products, infrastructure elements, tools, coatings, devices, vehicles and outpost modules when persistent state/control/maintenance/provenance warrants it.

identity_rule.not_everything_needs_identity: Disposable/static objects may remain catalogue/build records only. Promote to a persistent node when live state, maintenance, provenance, resource ledger, control, safety, public asset management or inter-node interaction benefits from identity.

compute_profiles.description: no local compute; identity via printed code/RFID/NFC/passive resonator; state interpreted externally
heavy reasoning delegated to Cognigrex/LightSpeed/Raphael federation

equivalence_rule: A physical object can be functionally phone-like, machine-like or infrastructure-like without reproducing commercial SoC transistor density. The .cgx identity binds distributed function and network reasoning; it does not create missing physical compute.
offline_rule: Safety and required deterministic control remain local; network loss must degrade to declared safe/local capability rather than undefined behavior.
authority: Frontier semantic object only until consumed by normal audited .cgx promotion.
